item.title: Critical vulnerabilities in Apache products
item.description:
Several vulnerabilities were published, see.
Vulnerabilities: Apache HTTP Server: request smuggling (CVE-2025-1111, CVSS 9.8), Apache Tomcat information disclosure (CVSS 5.3)

item.title: OpenSSL denial of service
item.description:
A single issue in OpenSSL.
Vulnerabilities: OpenSSL: crash on crafted certificate (CVSS 7.5)
